title: pvTemporalArrayOperator
body:
## pvTemporalArrayOperator

Combines one array at two of the input's stored time steps, chosen by zero-based indices (FirstTimeStepIndex, SecondTimeStepIndex), with +, -, * or / applied value by value as first-operator-second. The output is the dataset at the second step plus one new array named after the input array with a suffix (by default _add, _sub, _mul or _div), e.g. p_sub for the pressure change between two saved times. Both steps must hold the array with the same number of tuples and components, so the mesh must not change. Use temporalStatistics or pvTemporalStatistics for averages over all steps.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Both indices default to 0, which combines the first step with itself (ParaView only warns); set both.
- The input must report at least two time steps; indices count stored steps from 0, they are not time values.
- For integer arrays / is integer division; convert to floating point first (calculator).
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `TemporalArrayOperator`. Identity: `filters/TemporalArrayOperator`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the TemporalArrayOperator filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FirstTimeStepIndex` | This property specifies the timestep index to use in the first part of the comparison computation | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Operator` | The property determines the operation to compute between the first and second timestep data. | `{"type":"enum","values":["+","-","*","/"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"+"` |
| `OutputArrayNameSuffix` | This property set the suffix to be append to the output array name. If empty, output will be suffixed with '_' and the operation type. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `SecondTimeStepIndex` | This property specifies the timestep index to use in the second part of the comparison computation | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `SelectInputArray` | This property lists the name of the array from which to use. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
